trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own — no DLC and no online play is needed. The real work is the roadmap: finish the story first, then grind the 100% checklist for A Long Road, then clean up Strangers & Freaks and whatever is left. Budget around 200 hours in total.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 and it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 1. It pops a little late — PowerPyx notes the chapter trophies land once you clear the first mission or two of the next chapter, so keep playing and it will come.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 2 and it pops shortly after you start Chapter 3.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 3 and it pops shortly after you start Chapter 4.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 4 and it pops shortly after you start Chapter 5.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the final mission in Chapter 5 and the gold pops. Free roam continues after the story, so nothing is locked away by finishing it.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story mission trophy, unmissable. Complete the main mission Breakfast Run when it comes up in the story and it pops at the end of the mission.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story mission trophy, unmissable. Complete the main mission The Cartel Heist when it comes up in the story and it pops at the end of the mission.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story mission trophy, unmissable. Complete the main mission Child's Play when it comes up in the story and it pops at the end of the mission.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story mission trophy, unmissable. Complete the main mission Headliners when it comes up in the story and it pops at the end of the mission.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story mission trophy, unmissable. Complete the main mission VCIA Takedown when it comes up in the story and it pops at the end of the mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story mission trophy, unmissable. Complete the main mission Operation Savage Glory when it comes up in the story and it pops at the end of the mission.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. The checklist only opens after the story, but everything you did during the story already counts, and nothing on it is missable. PowerPyx calls it lenient — closer to 60% true completion: you need 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 stunts, 15 of 18 card sets, 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals studied. The parts that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Budget about 100 hours after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts of any kind — stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count and mix freely. PowerPyx counts 397 stunts in the game, and the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep jumping after this pops. Stunt jumps are the easiest to repeat.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt, per PowerPyx's list. One attempt at each is enough — you do not need to win or finish anything.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across 12 ranges. Gold the challenges at each range as you find it, then mop up the rest after the story. The 100% checklist needs every range too, so this is not a detour.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location — 14 in all. Each venue's race can be retried as often as you like, and the 100% checklist needs them all too.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, but repeat wins at the same event do not add to the count — keep moving to new events around Leonida.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. You meet Cal in Chapter 1 and he texts you a fishing spot afterwards — go there, take the challenge and out-fish him.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish any one in-game video game. Three run on the TV at home and a fourth on arcade machines — pick one and play it through to the end.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's side strand. Lucia only — it starts with a phone call in Chapter 3. Follow the strand to its final mission.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving strand: 7 shipwrecks in total. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and comes back later in the story, so do not worry if he vanishes — it is not missable.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand at the mud club in Kelly County. It opens in Chapter 2 — follow the strand to its final mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. PowerPyx counts 14 strands in the game and is still confirming exactly which ones count, so finish more than 8 to be safe. They can all be done after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's wish list of 16 sports cars. It opens in Chapter 3 — find the cars and deliver them as Randy asks.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand by shutting down the labs in Vice City. Jason only, from Chapter 3.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: during Chapter 1, one morning at Jason's house, Lucia says she is going to meditate and walks out to the balcony. Follow her and accept the optional quest — that meditation is gone after Chapter 1, and PowerPyx had done it when the trophy unlocked, so do it while you can. The other spots stay available; the last ones need both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Jason only, from Chapter 2. PowerPyx has not confirmed which animal triggers it yet — clearing all 15 of Bret's target decks, which the 100% checklist needs anyway, should cover it.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets out of 18. Cards are scattered across Leonida; the 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so this pops on the way to that.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count — scan everything the app highlights as you travel, and this comes naturally.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges. The 100% checklist wants 70, so this pops during cleanup — pick the easy challenges first and leave the hardest ones for last.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner along and escape. Possible once both characters can roam together in Chapter 2. Bank jobs give 4 stars anyway, so it often pops during a vault robbery — get clear of the heat with your partner beside you.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. PowerPyx says it pops about 30 seconds after the third shop — keep the wanted level alive between robberies and do not let it drop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning them with the WAiNK app is enough — you do not have to drive them. The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277, so scan every new vehicle you see.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. PowerPyx reports gang members count, while soldiers, police and civilians seem not to — pick a gang fight, trigger Combat Focus and drop five of them before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet docked at a gate at Vice City International Airport and fly about 1 km away from the airport. Expect a heavy response once you are airborne — get clear fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. PowerPyx found them at Mile Zero Air Station in the southwest — get in, get out, and survive the response that follows.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun, which a Chapter 3 main mission gives you — use it to get in and out unseen.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vault jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4; there are 8 in the game and each one brings a 4-star wanted level. The 100% checklist needs all 8.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The first bank job counts toward it, or you can blow open a truck's back door with a sticky bomb earlier.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the entire map. A plane is the fastest way to sweep the last corners of the state.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs. The 100% checklist needs all 39 operations, so this pops early in that cleanup.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact method is not confirmed by guide writers yet — head to a bar or venue on Ocean Beach with a view and order a drink, and check back as guides pin it down.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact method is not confirmed by guide writers yet — drive out through the showroom glass and frontage and see what triggers.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Take all 3 key valuables from the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn. The robbery comes back later if you miss something, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out strength on both Jason and Lucia. Work out together — both make progress when you train side by side.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Do 500 things that change your criminal profile. It comes naturally across a full playthrough — robberies, stunts, crimes and side work all feed it.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. PowerPyx suspects a link to a Payday Loans store — visit one and see what triggers; guides are still confirming it, so treat this as unconfirmed for now.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. PowerPyx suspects a UFO questline — keep an eye on strange lights and odd encounters around Leonida; guides are still confirming it, so treat this as unconfirmed for now.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. The in-game hint points to a melee attack from a moving vehicle, and PowerPyx suspects a kick from a motorcycle — try a melee strike from a moving bike.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. The dye pack jammer unlocks in a Chapter 3 main mission; marked bills from robberies add up across fences, so keep laundering as you rob.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos get you there fastest — big purchases count the same as small ones.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 in all. PowerPyx puts the total at about $160,000, and the real estate app arrives in Chapter 2.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. You need garage space first, so pair it with Little Boxes — buy the garages, then register vehicles to the app.
trophies.name: On the Spot
